lines.name: Skyport Line
lines.beyond: west to the West End along Circus Road

notes: Kept T1 and S1 as they are, both re-listed with order [trunk, loop]. I checked them by hand only; the plan checker has not been run. T1: the trunk runs in the Boulevard (28 m wide, x 0, z -780 to -37) and leaves the south sheet edge. The loop joins both tracks (±1.8 m) at z -56 with fillets of 25 to 28 m (minimum 25). Every fillet fits its segments: the r28 corners take exactly 56 m on the 56 m north side. The r28 arcs are centred on 0,0, inside the 31 m island.

S1: a double trunk at z 0 running over Circus Road's median, the circus island, Crown Parade (mall, x 43 to 288), Harbour Road (x 288 to 312, a 24 m span on the median) and the Skyport Pier. The loop runs over water with r40 fillets (minimum 40) at ±3 m beam offsets, stays inside x 740 and closes on the trunk end at x 560. It is two-way, which meets tide's 'two-way' requirement.

Rejected tide's Sky Loop round the district. A ring over the primary-road medians needs r70 or more at the four right-angle corners. A 90° r70 fillet cuts in about 29 m, past the 12 m half-width of a primary road, so it passes over built plots (fails S-C1, and S-P2 has no pylon zone there). The straight trunk does the same job with no rule failures.

Rejected T2 on Harbour Road. North it can leave the sheet at z 320, but its south end at z -720 is inside the sheet and needs a turning loop (T-L1). A loop of r25 or more needs about 50 m and won't fit in a 24 m street. A 90° r50 turn onto Comet Row or Market Street cuts in about 21 m, past the street's 12 m half-width (fails T-C1). A T2 needs a road change first, e.g. a turning space or a wider junction at Harbour Road × Comet Row. That is a road-plan question I am raising with Aster, not a lines edit.

Did not extend T1 up Crown Avenue (questions note): Crown Avenue stops at Crown Road (z 280), short of the sheet edge (z 320). So it would need another in-sheet loop, and the circus balloon already serves that end.
N-C1: Vantage's current interchange is the T1 Crown Circus stop (0,-72) with S1 Crown Circus (95,0), about 119 m apart, inside the 150 m limit. With only two lines, that single interchange is enough.

Source mismatch for Aster: the plan's notes/why still describe the old draft (single-track tram with no loop, a 24 m Sphere loop, a separate Harbour loop). They contradict notes/concept and the current lines, which I followed.

Reach (250 m) is judged per area. Area centres are within reach of current stops, but corner plots at x ±260 (lantern-west, rocket-west, docks-east, harbour-east) are about 270 to 320 m from any stop on these alignments. If the checker measures per plot, that is the case for a later east-side tram once roads allow one.
